releases.notes: # Update 1.4.0 This release only supports English. For Chinese, please wait for the release has _GlassPlus CN Developer Kit Fabric_ come out. **这个 release 仅支持英文，对于中文使用者，请等待有 _GlassPlus CN Developer Kit Fabric_ 字样的release发布** ## Changes - Replace /sp with /superpotion - Remove /gpinfo, /gpmodinfo - **Added command execution feedback for /sp** - **Adjusted the level of haste provided by /efh from 256 to 128** - Fix 3 bugs ## Commands - Added /glassinfo to check the version of the mod - Added /tsd, /tsno, /tsni, /tsmn to set time to day, noon, night, midnight - Added /sp to get a potion which has most of the buff - Added /sp, it has the same effect as /spawnpoint - Added /xpmax to increase the player's level by 238609310 - Added /swordofbasic to get a diamond sword has unbreaking III, sharpness V, sweeping edge III - Added /swordoflooting to get a diamond sword has unbreaking III, sharpness V, sweeping edge III, Looting III - Added /swordofsuper to get a UNBREAKABLE diamond sword has unbreaking III, sharpness V, sweeping edge III, Lootig III - **Added /levitation to gives the player a level 10 levitation effect for a short time** - **Added /luckon, /luckoff to on and off Super Lucky Mode** This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/WForst-Breeze/glassplus-developerkit/compare/v1.3.3...v1.4.0
